property_summary: After a successful burn(x) by the owner, the total supply must decrease by exactly the burned amount (x); the bug breaks this because totalSupply remains unchanged while balanceOf decreases, so totalSupply - (previous totalSupply - x) != 0.
change_summary: Remove the totalSupply decrement line in burn so totalSupply does not decrease, which causes balanceOf to be unchanged at the owner key while totalSupply remains high.
